ROW.COLUMN: (FR/AC) Change of Address or Phone Number Check Book Issue

Financial institutions typically monitor activities in certain type(s) of special interest accounts such as corporate accounts that change their address or phone number before, after or on the day of issue of their check book. This sequence of activities alone may not be considered as a behavior of fraudulent activities, however could be the potential starting point and may warrant additional early warning investigation and take necessary preventive actions.
Chg of Addr or Ph Chk Iss

with ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ----All the accounts having a check book issue within the lookback period ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Check_Book_Issue as ( select A.ACCT_INTRL_ID as Acct_intrl_id, A.ACCT_SEQ_ID as Acct_seq_id, AE.ACCESS_EVENT_DT as Access_Event_Dt from @BUSINESS@.ACCT A inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT_ACCESS_EVENT AE on AE.ACCT_INTRL_ID=A.ACCT_INTRL_ID where ---Filter : " Include active accounts only A.ACCT_STAT_CD ='A' ---Filter : Exclude Exempt Accounts and A.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 ---Parameter: "All Jurisdictions" , "Included Jurisdiction Codes" ,"Included Account Type Codes" and ( A.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD in (@Incld_Acct_Type_Codes ) and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' or A.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incld_Jurisdictions_Lst )) ) ---Parameter: "All Access Event Primary Purpose" ,"Included Access Event Primary Purpose" and (@All_Access_Event_Primary_Purpose = 'N' or AE.PRMRY_PURP_DESC_TX in (@Incld_Access_Event_Primary_Purpose)) ---Parameter: "Mantas Business Acct Types"--- and A.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD in (@Incld_Business_Acct_Typ) ---Parameter: "All Trxn Channels" ,"Included Trxn Channel" and (@All_Trxn_Chnls = 'Y' or AE.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_CD in (@Incl_Trxn_Chnl_Lst)) ---Parameter: "All Transaction Sources","Included Trxn Source Codes " and (@All_Trans_Src_Fl = 'Y' or AE.SRC_SYS_CD in (@Incld_Trans_Src_Lst )) ---Check Book Issue during the lookback period ---Parameter: "Calendar Name" , "Lookback Period" and AE.ACCESS_EVENT_DT > (select ADD_DAYS(B.CLNDR_DT,-@Lookback_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and AE.ACCESS_EVENT_DT <=(select B.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM =@Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) )
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ----All the address or phone number changes happened , prior and post check book issue date ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ,Add_Ph_Change as ( ----All the address and phone changes happened , prior and post check book issue date select CB. Acct_intrl_id as Acct_intrl_id, CB.Acct_seq_id as Acct_seq_id from Check_Book_Issue CB inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT_CHG_LOG_SMRY CL on CL.ACCT_INTRL_ID =CB.Acct_intrl_id where ---Parameter: "Prior Day" CL.CHG_DT >= (CB.ACCESS_EVENT_DT-@Prior_Day ) ---Parameter: "Post Day" and CL.CHG_DT<=(CB.ACCESS_EVENT_DT+@Post_Day ) group by CB. Acct_intrl_id,CB.Acct_seq_id )
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ----Main Query ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- select R.ACCT_INTRL_ID, R.ACCT_SEQ_ID, sum(R.ADDR_CHG_CT) as ADDR_CHG_CT, sum(R.PHONE_CHG_CT) as PHONE_CHG_CT, max(R.DATA_DUMP_DT) as CURR_DAY from ( select AP.Acct_intrl_id, AP.Acct_seq_id, CL.ACCT_ADDR_CHG_CT as ADDR_CHG_CT, CL.PHON_CHG_CT as PHONE_CHG_CT, AB.NET_WRTH_AM, AB.DATA_DUMP_DT from Add_Ph_Change AP inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT_CHG_LOG_SMRY CL on CL.ACCT_INTRL_ID =AP.Acct_intrl_id inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT_BAL_POSN_SMRY AB on AP.Acct_intrl_id =AB.ACCT_INTRL_ID where ---Filter : Change happened within Lookback Period+Prior Day CL.CHG_DT > (select ADD_DAYS(B.CLNDR_DT,-(@Lookback_Period+@Prior_Day)) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and CL.CHG_DT <=(select B.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM =@Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) ---Filter : To get Current Account Balance and AB.DATA_DUMP_DT =(select B.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM =@Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) ) R group by R.ACCT_INTRL_ID, R.ACCT_SEQ_ID ---Parameter : " Min Balance Amt" having max( R.NET_WRTH_AM) <@Min_Balance_Amt or max( R.NET_WRTH_AM) >=@Min_Balance_Amt

select A.ACCT_INTRL_ID, ACCESS_EVENT_SEQ_ID from @BUSINESS@.ACCT A inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT_ACCESS_EVENT AE on AE.ACCT_INTRL_ID=A.ACCT_INTRL_ID where ---Filter : " Include active accounts only A.ACCT_STAT_CD ='A' ---Filter : Exclude Exempt Accounts and A.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 ---Parameter: "All Jurisdictions" , "Included Jurisdiction Codes" ,"Included Account Type Codes" and ( A.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD in (@Incld_Acct_Type_Codes ) and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' or A.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incld_Jurisdictions_Lst )) ) ---Parameter: "All Access Event Primary Purpose" ,"Included Access Event Primary Purpose" and (@All_Access_Event_Primary_Purpose = 'N' or AE.PRMRY_PURP_DESC_TX in (@Incld_Access_Event_Primary_Purpose)) ---Parameter: "Mantas Business Acct Types"--- and A.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD in (@Incld_Business_Acct_Typ) ---Parameter: "All Trxn Channels" ,"Included Trxn Channel" and (@All_Trxn_Chnls = 'Y' or AE.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_CD in (@Incl_Trxn_Chnl_Lst)) ---Parameter: "All Transaction Sources","Included Trxn Source Codes " and (@All_Trans_Src_Fl = 'Y' or AE.SRC_SYS_CD in (@Incld_Trans_Src_Lst )) ---Check Book Issue during the lookback period ---Parameter: "Calendar Name" , "Lookback Period" and AE.ACCESS_EVENT_DT > (select ADD_DAYS(B.CLNDR_DT,-@Lookback_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and AE.ACCESS_EVENT_DT <=(select B.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM =@Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0)

select DS.ACCT_INTRL_ID, CL.ACCT_CHG_LOG_SMRY_SEQ_ID from @MINER@.DSVIEW118745339 DS inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT_CHG_LOG_SMRY CL on CL.ACCT_INTRL_ID =DS.ACCT_INTRL_ID where ---Filter : Change happened within Lookback Period+Prior Day CL.CHG_DT > (select ADD_DAYS(B.CLNDR_DT,-(@Lookback_Period+@Prior_Day)) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and CL.CHG_DT <=(select B.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM =@Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0)

Parameter that allows the coverage of all jurisdictions without enumerating them in the Included Jurisdiction Codes threshold. Y: Covers all jurisdiction codes regardless of the Included Jurisdiction Code threshold value. N: Covers only those jurisdictions that are listed in the Included Jurisdiction Codes threshold.

Parameter that allows the coverage of all Access Event Primary Purpose without enumerating them in the Included Access Event Primary Purpose threshold. Y: Covers all Access Event Primary Purpose regardless of the Included Access Event Primary Purpose threshold value. N: Covers only those Access Event Primary Purpose that are listed in the Included Access Event Primary Purpose threshold.

Parameter that allows the coverage of all transaction channel codes for Non-financial transactions / inquiries without enumerating them in the Included Trxn Channel threshold. Y: Covers all transaction channel codes for Non-financial transactions / inquiries regardless of the Included Trxn Channel threshold value. N: Covers only those transaction channel codes for Non-financial transactions / inquiries that are listed in the Included Trxn Channel threshold.

Parameter that allows the coverage of all transaction source codes without enumerating them in the Included Transaction Source Codes threshold: Y: Covers all transaction source codes regardless of the Included Transaction Source Codes threshold value. N: Covers only those transaction source codes that are listed in the Included Transaction Source Codes threshold.
The name of the calendar to be used in this scenario. This is to accommodate calendars from different countries if needed.
Number of previous day(s) to check for address or phone number change from check book issue date in this scenario.
Number of post day(s) to check for address or phone number change from check book issue date in this scenario.
List of account type codes covered by this scenario. Allowable values are defined in the Account: Mantas Account Holder Type field in the Account Data Code Values table in the DIS.
The list of jurisdiction codes that the scenario covers. The client defines allowable values.
List of transaction source codes that the scenario covers. The client defines the allowable values.
The list of transaction channel codes for Non-financial transaction / inquiries covered in this scenario.

The list of account access event primary purpose considered as issuing of check book in this scenario. The firm defines allowable values for the Access Event: Primary Purpose of Access Event field, as described in the DIS.
Number of business days in the lookback period.
Codes that identify the business purpose or usage of this account for Mantas scenarios.
Minimum account balance needed to generate alert in this scenario if account balance is not negative.
